boundaries.name: deterministic-harness-key-derivation-is-production-reachable
boundaries.obligation: `pub mod test_utils;` in src/circuits/mod.rs carries no cfg(test) and re-exports these generator modules, so `deterministic_member_falcon_keys`, `ChannelMemberKeys::deterministic`, `add_channel_registration` and `register_channel` compile into production builds. Every member Falcon signing key of a fixture-registered channel is a pure function of the PUBLIC channel id. Discharging this requires actually cfg-gating or extracting the harness key material; the model only records the reachability and the derivation.

boundaries.name: poseidon-keccak-and-merkle-callbacks
boundaries.obligation: Member roots, channel/send/deposit/public-state roots and openings, the block and deposit keccak chain steps and the channel-registration chain step are opaque callbacks. Prove collision resistance, correct leaf hashing, path-index decomposition and real tree ownership; an equal returned root is not authenticated state.

boundaries.name: falcon-signing-and-blob-decoding
boundaries.obligation: `FalconKeys::sign`, `decode_cosign_blob`, `falcon_pk_digest` and `FalconSigGadgetWitness::for_signature` are callbacks. A produced or decoded signature is not authorization, and `falcon_pk_digest(h) == pk_g` rebinds an identity only under hash injectivity, which is not assumed.

boundaries.name: agg-list-commitment-and-plonky2-recursion
boundaries.obligation: `agg_list_commitment` and `build_agg_sig_list_proof`'s recursive FalconAggCircuit/AggListCircuit proving are not modeled beyond the refusal precondition. Prove that the folded commitment equals what the validity circuit asserts against `final.bp_sig_chain`.

boundaries.name: pinned-callee-body
boundaries.obligation: `channel_leaf_member_root` (src/circuits/validity/block_hash_chain/update_channel_tree.rs:163-170) is pinned here as the identity on `prev_member_pubkeys_root`. `member_set_advance_is_unreachable_from_add_block` is only valid while that body is unchanged; re-verify on any change to that callee.

boundaries.name: native-panics-are-not-recoverable
boundaries.obligation: Rust `assert!`/`assert_eq!`/`expect`/`panic!` and integer overflow abort the process; the model represents them as a distinguished `GenError.nativePanic` purely to keep their position in the check order visible. Prove that no modeled panic is reachable, or that aborting is acceptable at each site.

boundaries.name: witness-construction-is-not-a-circuit-constraint
boundaries.obligation: Every check modeled here is a native admission condition of THIS builder. An adversary can hand an arbitrary witness to the prover; nothing in this module constrains that path. Any safety claim must come from the circuits, not from these generators.

boundaries.name: nullifier-insertion-and-freshness
boundaries.obligation: `prove_and_insert` on the indexed nullifier tree and `UpdatePrivateState::new` are callbacks. A returned insertion proof is not no-reuse and a changed root is not freshness.

boundaries.name: proof-values-and-public-input-parsing
boundaries.obligation: plonky2 `ProofWithPublicInputs` values are modeled only by their parsed `BalancePublicInputs`. Proof validity, `BalancePublicInputs::from_u64` decoding and the balance processor are out of scope.
